_note: preview_strategy_report response, VERBATIM. Deliberate header collision: RSI14 value at offset 0 and offset 3 compile to the SAME header, because `offset` changes the value and never appears in the header. The platform accepts it silently - no error, no dedupe - renders both columns under the duplicate name with different values (62.7 and 67.8), and then OMITS the entire custom section from conditionColumns. Compare any other capture in this directory, where conditionColumns[0] is the custom section; here conditionColumns starts at session-field and the custom section is absent. Consequence: the agent can read the table while no condition can reference any column in it. omega.validate now raises DUPLICATE_HEADER for this up front.
